APPROVE

The extracted `ContinueQuote` and `IsShebang` keep the original quote-skipping and `#!` logic exactly, and `ref i` on a `for` loop variable compiles. Moving the nested ifs out and adding one ternary should cut the cognitive complexity from 16 to roughly 11. I only reviewed the diff; the repo isn't available here, so I haven't built it or run the tests.
